title: Offline container rotation and OCI curation notes
body:
Goal: capture a pragmatic, repeatable workflow for curating OCI artifact bundles for air-gapped private installs, handling image rotation (immutability and garbage collection), signing and verification, and terraform module interfaces for bootstrap and upgrade paths.

Scope:
- Container images (server, sidecars, infra images) and their manifests
- Helm charts and tarballs as artifact layers
- OCI index handling for multi-arch images
- Sneakernet physical media workflows and checksums
- Terraform variables and outputs needed for automation
- Upgrade canary strategy and rollback primitives

Assumptions and constraints:
- Customers often use Harbor, Nexus, or Artifactory as offline registries; keep steps registry-agnostic using skopeo, oras, crane, or containerd tools.
- No direct egress from the customer cluster during install or upgrade.
- Requirement: end-to-end verification using cosign and deterministic bundle composition.

Inventory and manifest model (recommended):
- curated-bundle.json lists artifacts by role (control-plane, runtime, sidecar), image sha256, tags, size, platform.
- Companion bundle SHA256 file and a signed bundle metadata file created with cosign.
- Example entries should use pinned digests not tags.

Tooling recommendations and example commands:
- Mirror images from upstream to internal registry (on internet machine):
  skopeo copy docker://ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v1.8.2 docker://registry-internal.example.com/control-plane/runtime:v1.8.2
  oras copy ghcr.io/redwood/helm-charts/runtime:1.8.2 oras://registry-internal.example.com/helm/runtime:1.8.2 --manifest-config config.json
- Save tarball for sneakernet media:
  docker pull ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v1.8.2 && docker save ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v1.8.2 -o runtime_v1.8.2.tar
  sha256sum runtime_v1.8.2.tar > runtime_v1.8.2.tar.sha256
- Load into air-gapped registry on customer jumpbox:
  crane cp runtime_v1.8.2.tar oci:./oci-layout:runtime_v1.8.2
  skopeo copy oci:./oci-layout:runtime_v1.8.2 docker://localhost:5000/control-plane/runtime:v1.8.2
- Signing and verification with cosign:
  cosign sign --key k8s://namespace/airgap-key registry-internal.example.com/control-plane/runtime@sha256:abcd...
  cosign verify --key k8s://namespace/airgap-key registry-internal.example.com/control-plane/runtime@sha256:abcd...

OCI index and multi-arch notes:
- Create OCI index when bundling multi-arch variants and record the index in curated-bundle.json.
- Always reference images by digest in customer manifests and overlays to avoid implicit tag rewrites.

Terraform module interface notes for registry-mirror module:
- Inputs: mirror_registry_endpoint, mirror_credentials_secret_name, bundle_manifest_s3_path, allowed_storage_classes.
- Outputs: bootstrap_jumpbox_ip, registry_root.
- Implementation: module should optionally provision an ephemeral hardened jumpbox for import and verification. Provide a submodule to deploy a registry (Harbor) with TLS and robot account creation. Expose ignore_changes for rotation related fields; rotation happens out-of-band.

Example HCL artifact list variable example:
variable "curated_artifacts" { type = list(string) default = [ "registry-internal.example.com/control-plane/runtime@sha256:abcd...", "registry-internal.example.com/sidecar/proxy@sha256:ef12..." ] }

Operational workflow (install and upgrade):
1) Curate images and create curated-bundle.json, bundle.tar.gz, and cosign signatures on an internet connected machine.
2) Transfer bundle via sneakernet or secure staging object store.
3) On customer jumpbox verify checksums and cosign signatures before importing.
4) Import images into registry and run basic smoke pulls.
5) Deploy to staging namespace referencing digests for canary testing.
6) Run acceptance checks including readiness and health endpoints.
7) Promote digest to stable tag in internal registry and update operator config.
8) Rollout with controlled concurrency and monitor signals.

Upgrade specifics and rollback hooks:
- Default canary size 1-2 pods for control-plane components.
- Require at least two independent signals (readiness and API latency) to proceed.
- Keep previous digest in curated-bundle.json as immediate fallback; operator should support quick rebind to previous digest.
- Database migrations must be explicit separate steps after canary verification and before wide rollout.

Garbage collection and retention policy recommendations:
- Retain digests for a support aligned window (example 90 days) and optionally move to cold storage.
- Configure registry immutability or retention to protect release digests; ensure GC does not remove live release digests.

Sneakernet checklist for media handoffs:
- Prepare manifest, tarballs, checksums, and cosign signatures.
- Verify locally before shipping.
- Use tamper evident packaging and record serial numbers.
- On receipt verify SHA256 and cosign signatures before import.

Failure modes and mitigations:
- Mismatched digests: abort import and request re-export.
- Cosign verification failure: rotate signing keys out-of-band and re-sign; preserve key history.
- Partial import: detect failures and re-run import operations; provide idempotent import scripts.

Open action items:
- Author curate-and-export.sh to automate skopeo, oras, and crane flows and emit curated-bundle.json (owner Ravi Patel).
- Add terraform submodule example for ephemeral jumpbox and harbor with robot accounts (owner Maya Chen).
- Draft acceptance e2e checklist for staging job (owner Liam O'Neill).

References and links: cosign project: https://github.com/sigstore/cosign; skopeo and oras docs; internal PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/airgap-terraform/pull/42

Notes: Convert this checklist into a runnable script and a small validator tool that checks curated-bundle.json and orchestrates import with retries. Provide appendices with steps for Harbor, Nexus, and ECR in follow-up.
